skill-respect-sites: For LinkedIn, provide ready-made search links the user can open themselves. If they share a posting, ask for its text; do not automate or fetch LinkedIn pages.
skill-search-sources:
2. **Pick sources for the field.** `dailyberlinjobs`, `ats` and `freehire` only list **tech,
   engineering and data roles**. For other fields, use `ba,arbeitnow`. For LinkedIn, provide
   ready-made search links from `references/browser-search.md` for the user to open themselves.

   | Field | Sources | Title filter |
   |---|---|---|
   | Software, data, IT | defaults (`dailyberlinjobs,ba,arbeitnow,ats`) | off (skill words like "Python" appear outside titles) |
   | Everything else | `ba,arbeitnow` | `--title-match` (BA matches its full text loosely) |
3. **Run** each query with the listed sources. Report any source marked failed in `meta.sources`
   and carry on with other sources. For non-tech fields, also give the user StepStone, Indeed and
   XING links from `references/browser-search.md`.
4. Use `references/browser-search.md` for user-operated LinkedIn and other portal searches.
skill-web-search-fallback:
- **Web search** for BA, StepStone and Indeed postings. The BA API needs a request header
  that web fetch can't send, so search its website instead. For LinkedIn, provide a ready-made
  search link for the user to open.
api-default-sources: Default sources in this package: `dailyberlinjobs,ba,arbeitnow,ats`; Freehire is opt-in. LinkedIn is not an automated source here; provide ready-made search links from `browser-search.md` for the user to open themselves.
api-linkedin-section:
## LinkedIn

LinkedIn search is not an automated source in this package. Give the user a ready-made search link from `browser-search.md` to open themselves. If they share a posting, ask them to paste its text.
browser-linkedin-section:
## LinkedIn Jobs

Give the user a ready-made search link to open themselves, for example:
[Data analyst jobs in Berlin](https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords=data%20analyst&location=Berlin%2C%20Germany).
They can adjust filters and review postings directly on LinkedIn.
job-sources-note: search directly on LinkedIn's website and open results yourself
